title: The year summer never came ❄️
subject: volcano
description:
Would you have guessed a volcano? 👇

In 1816, the Year Without a Summer, snow fell in New England in June and harvests failed across Europe. The cause was the 1815 eruption of Mount Tambora in Indonesia.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine ("Blast from the Past"), UCAR Center for Science Education ("Mount Tambora and the Year Without a Summer")

scenes.text: New England, 1816. Frost killed crops as far south as Virginia.
In Europe, cold rain fell for weeks and harvests failed.
But here's the strange part. The cause was a volcano on the other side of the world.
In 1815, Indonesia's Mount Tambora had the biggest eruption in recorded history. About 90,000 people died, mostly from hunger. Its haze cooled the planet.
